newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan to auction six-month maturity bonds.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan to auction six-month maturity bonds.

text.p: The State (central) Bank of Pakistan said on Thursday it had invited bids from Friday to Saturday for the auction of six-month maturity short-term federal bonds.

A bank statement said the auction result would be announced on Monday with settlement set for Tuesday. A pre-auction target of five billion rupees had been set, but bids could be rejected without giving any reason.
In the last auction on June 30, bids worth 4.755 billion rupees were accepted at a weighted average yield of 16.24988 percent per annum. -- ($1=40.56)
